findings.F1: The tested effect sits on the predicted side but is weak and uneven. Over all folds the next-day unusual move is +0.30 % (t 1.00, 321 cases, 186 days). In the visible folds B and C it is +1.25 % (t 2.52, 105 cases, strength 0.196), which means folds A and D carry almost none of it.
findings.F2: Even inside folds B and C the effect is concentrated in time. It is strong in w9 (+2.09 %, t 4.37, 13 cases), w12 (+2.32 %, t 1.79) and w14 (+3.19 %, t 1.90). It is flat or reversed in w15 (0.00 %), w17 (-0.27 %) and w18 (-0.83 %, t -0.91, 16 cases). By year it is +1.96 % in 2018 and +1.48 % in 2019, against +0.04 % in 2020 and +0.58 % in 2021.
findings.F3: The grading by close location works and the grading by width does not. Across the 89 cases with both measures, the slope of the next-day unusual move on close location is +0.123 (t 2.29). The slope on width is -0.0033 (t -0.87), and the slope on the plan's combined |forecast| is -0.0004 (t -0.18). The supporting check therefore rests on the wrong grader.
findings.F4: Sorted by close location, the next-day fade grows step by step. It is +0.62 % (t 0.92, 46 cases) for closes at 0.75–0.85 of the range, +1.62 % (t 2.49, 43 cases) at 0.85–0.95, and +2.06 % (t 1.74, 16 cases) at 0.95–1.0. By width tercile it is flat or falling: +1.29 %, +1.29 %, +0.90 %.
findings.F5: The falling, calm profile matters. Wide, high-closing days outside the profile show only +0.41 % next-day unusual move (t 0.83, 396 cases), and nothing over 2 to 3 days (-0.35 %, -0.53 %). The profile's cases show +1.25 % (F1).
findings.F6: The test already used every coin and every fold available, so no more data exists for this idea. Its total move per case (+0.16 %) is 0.7 times the 0.22 % cost of a trade, so the effect only becomes usable if a sharper grader enlarges the move per case.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, a day whose high-to-low range is wide against the coin's 30-day swing of daily returns and that closes near its high is followed by a fall over the next day, larger the closer the close sits to the day's high.
ideas.consequence: In a falling, calm coin, a wide day that ends right at its high is a fade for the next day, and the case for it strengthens with how tightly the close pins the high rather than with how wide the day was.
ideas.name: falling calm high-close fade
